  • At Delta Hotels by Marriott, we like to keep things simple and get them done right. We\u00e2\u0080\u0099re a busy, friendly team, and we\u00e2\u0080\u0099re looking for a handy, reliable Maintenance Team Member to help us keep the hotel looking sharp and running smoothly.

We are looking for a highly motivated person with real \"can do\" attitude. If you're someone who loves solving problems, stays positive when things get busy, and takes pride in a job well done, we want to hear from you!

What You\u00e2\u0080\u0099ll Be Doing

  • Assist with planned preventive maintenance (PPM): General repairs like painting, changing silicone, or basic plumbing and electrical jobs.
  • Keeping rooms in perfect conditions: Doing regular walk-throughs to catch little issues (like a loose door handle or a burnt out lightbulb) before a guest does.
  • Helping our guests: Heading up to guest rooms to fix any quick issues with a smile and a \"no problem\" attitude.
  • Working as a team: Supporting the Maintenance Manager and helping other departments .
  • Staying safe: Following the usual health and safety rules to keep yourself, the team, and our guests safe.
  • Sorting the workshop: Keeping your tools tidy and letting us know when we\u00e2\u0080\u0099re running low on supplies.

What We Expect

  • A flexible approach to working hours (including one weekend a month)
  • Previous experience in maintenance or handyman role is preferred
  • An electrical or plumbing qualification is a bonus but not required
  • Attention to details and practical problem solving

What is in it for you: In addition to receiving a competitive salary and investment in your personal development, you will have access to an array of perks and discounts including:

  • Free Meals on Duty: Enjoy complimentary meals while at work.
  • Call out Surcharge: A supplementary payment while on call for the hotel
  • Uniform Provided: A professional uniform is supplied for all employees.

  • Employee Assistance Programme: Free and confidential support for various challenges, including financial advice, stress, and health issues.
  • Career Development: Opportunities for career growth and internal transfers within Marriott's global network.
  • Training and Development: Access to training programs to enhance your skills and advance your career.

Note: This above description is not intended to establish a total definition of the job, but an outline of the duties.
